_meta.description: Selectors for the LinkedIn job-status verifier. Update when LinkedIn changes its DOM.

auth_check.expired_url_patterns_doc: Substrings in the final URL that indicate the saved session is no longer valid; LinkedIn redirects unauthenticated requests to one of these paths.

expired_url_patterns_doc: Substrings in the final URL that indicate the JOB (not the session) has expired. LinkedIn redirects requests for deleted/closed job IDs to a generic 'similar jobs' search page with trk=expired_jd_redirect appended.
expired_markers_doc: Page elements observed on closed/expired or 404'd LinkedIn job listings. First match wins. 404 markers come first to handle the case where LinkedIn returns 200 OK on a deleted job_id but renders a 'Page not found' template in many locales.
expired_markers: text=This job is no longer available
active_markers_doc: Page elements present on listings that are still accepting applications. LinkedIn serves two layouts depending on auth state: (1) authenticated 'jobs-*' classes when the saved session works, (2) 'top-card-layout__*' / 'apply-button' / 'description__text' classes on the public/guest view. Both layouts indicate an active listing — only the apply path differs. Checked only after expired_markers misses.
